intro: Zaxby's is a Southern chicken chain famous for hand-breaded Chicken Fingerz, wings tossed in bold sauces, loaded Zalads and the signature Zax Sauce. Most meals come with crinkle fries, Texas toast and a drink. Below is the full Zaxby's menu with prices and calories for 2026, organized by category.
quick_answer: Zaxby's is built around hand-breaded Chicken Fingerz and wings. A 5 Chicken Fingerz Meal is about $10.24, the Big Zax Snak Meal (3 fingerz, fries, toast and Zax Sauce) is around $10.81, and the Chicken Finger Plate is about $15.69. Boneless wing meals start near $8.99.
hot_deal: Zaxby's value: the Big Zax Snak Meal (3 Chicken Fingerz, crinkle fries, Texas toast and Zax Sauce) is the go-to at about $10.81, and boneless wing meals start near $8.99. Zaxby's also runs app-only deals and a rewards program. Offers vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a Chicken Finger Plate at Zaxby's?
faqs.a: The Chicken Finger Plate is about $15.69 and includes four Chicken Fingerz, crinkle fries, Texas toast, coleslaw and sauce. It is roughly 1,340 calories.

faqs.q: What is the Big Zax Snak Meal?
faqs.a: The Big Zax Snak Meal is Zaxby's most popular value meal: three Chicken Fingerz, crinkle fries, Texas toast and Zax Sauce for about $10.81, around 1,000 calories.
Zax Sauce is Zaxby's signature creamy, peppery dipping sauce served with fingerz and fries. It is the flavor most people associate with the brand.

faqs.q: What is the difference between boneless and traditional wings at Zaxby's?
faqs.a: Boneless wings are breaded white-meat bites and start around $8.99 for a 5-piece meal. Traditional wings are bone-in and start about $11.49 for a 5-piece meal. Both come in several sauces.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Zaxby's?
faqs.a: The best known are the Chicken Fingerz, the Big Zax Snak Meal, boneless wings, the signature Zax Sauce, and the Cobb Zalad.
